parties: The President of India (through Ministry of Mines) | Hindustan Copper Limited
headline: Hindustan Copper Limited: Offer for sale by Government of India
sum: Government of India initiates OFS of 2.90 crore equity shares (₹5 face value) in Hindustan Copper Limited via stock exchange mechanism, floor price ₹514/share. Non-retail tranche closes 25 Aug 2026; retail tranche 26 Aug 2026.
implication: Disinvestment via exchange-traded OFS mechanism triggers disclosure, listing compliance, and SEBI insider trading restrictions; counsel must advise on quiet period and price stabilization rules during the two-tranche offering window.
detail: The Ministry of Mines, representing the President of India (GOI), announced an OFS of 2,90,10,721 equity shares (face value ₹5 each) in Hindustan Copper Limited. The floor price was set at ₹514 per share, implying a transaction value of approximately ₹149 crores at floor. The offering was bifurcated: non-retail investors (HNIs/institutions) bid on 25 Aug 2026 (9:15 a.m.–3:30 p.m. IST); retail investors on 26 Aug 2026 (9:15 a.m.–3:30 p.m. IST), each on a separate window of NSE and BSE. This is a Government of India disinvestment exercise, reducing stake in a central public sector undertaking (CPSU).

framework.ref: SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, Reg. 3(1)
framework.note: Restricts insider dealing and trading during price-sensitive periods; applicable to GOI and HCCL insiders during OFS window.

framework.ref: SEBI (Buyback of Securities) Regulations, 1998 (to extent if price stabilization engaged)
framework.note: If underwriter stabilizes post-OFS, price stabilization rules apply; requires disclosure.

Applies to equity shares of listed company; prescribed procedure for capital issuance/sale.

framework.note: Governs GOI disinvestment method, floor price fixation, and approval for OFS in CPSEs.
Internal governance for equity sale and transfer; may restrict alienation or require board/shareholder approval.
